title: Star detectors read before luminance buffer on short images
summary: Fast and precise scan image edges when height < 4; 144 x 3 MONO16 with bright pixel zero reproduces a 2-byte heap overread before the 864-byte luminance buffer under ASan. Ensure every scanned candidate has valid 8-neighbors or reject unsupported geometry; verify all formats and small dimensions.
evidence: verification.md and sanitizer-verification.log; direct-source ASan/UBSan reproduction.
